examples.name: Collision -> variable increment (a score counter)
Spawning on a timer, resetting it
Frame-rate independent movement and a collision
examples.source:
always:
  SetX(Player, GetX(Player) + 250 * TimeDelta())
if Collision(Player, Spike):
  Delete(Player)

examples.name: Trigger-once shooting
Else chains over the scene state
examples.source:
always:
  SetNumberVariable(Score, =, Score + 1)
else if DepartScene():
  SetNumberVariable(Score, =, Score + 50)
  ResetTimer("RoundTimer")

examples.name: For-each iteration over instances
Iterating the children of a structure variable
examples.source:
for each child in SaveData value Items:
  SetStringVariable(ItemName, =, child)

examples.name: Loops, sub-events and a group
examples.source:
group "Waves":
repeat 3 times:
  if Timer(1, "WaveTimer") and once:
    ResetTimer("WaveTimer")
    if not SceneVariableAsBoolean(BossAlive):
      Create(Enemy, Random(800), 0, "Base layer")
  always:
    SetNumberVariable(WaveProgress, =, WaveProgress + 1)

examples.name: Comments, anchors, disabled events and links
examples.source:
comment "The setup below runs once at the start of the scene"
always: # event-3.1
  SetNumberVariable(Score, =, 0)
disabled always:
  Wait(1)
link "Shared enemy logic"
